label: Model estimate (experimental), not an official fire warning.
briefing: For 14 Nov - 20 Nov 2026, the model expects fire in about 103 of the 7,774 cells (5 km) of this area that have burned before (1.3 %). The highest chance in one cell is 95 %. If fires happen, their intensity would most likely be high. Based on 519 NASA FIRMS VIIRS NOAA-20 detections here in the 28 days up to 13 Nov 2026. Model estimate (experimental), not an official fire warning.

reliability.note: Tested on 2023-2025, years the model never saw: AUC 0.87 (1 = perfect, 0.5 = coin flip). Using only the usual pattern for that week of the year gives 0.76.
